scope.purpose: Return the recent number/operator tests to the existing A0 Research Desk as a typed, machine-readable test chain.
scope.claim_policy: Exact identities and bounded operator results remain distinct from visual analogy, glyph language, external significance and physical mechanism.

chains.title: Cassini / Euler parity selector
chains.finding: The Cassini sign is an exact two-channel selector, but parity alone reproduces every selected Euler output.
chains.boundary: No deeper Fibonacci-to-Euler generator is established.

chains.title: 41 prime-triple decoder
chains.finding: The declared double path uniquely returns (P1,P2,P4)=(2,3,7), while the two-point affine decoder is saturated.
chains.boundary: Internal uniqueness is exact; external significance remains untested and post-hoc.

chains.title: 11–12–13 zither / decimal carry / T64 ring
chains.finding: The chain fixes 181,202,223 with step 21, proves the 383/404 identities, and cross-checks 137→8 under T64 on Z365.
chains.boundary: Palindrome and loop/glyph readings are representation-dependent; typed appearances of 8 are not identified.

chains.title: MOD2501 / CRT two-channel operator system
chains.finding: CRT split/bind and registered operators work on Z365 and Z2501; the M64 orbit structure changes with the carrier.
chains.boundary: A modulus is a declared carrier and operator context, not an intrinsic meaning of a numeral.

chains.title: M64 Janus-sector transfer
chains.finding: The mirror equalizer has size gcd(65,m): five states on Z365 and only zero on Z2501.
chains.boundary: The nontrivial Janus sector is carrier-bound; it does not transfer as an intrinsic property of 64.

method_guards.emp03: Separate observable invariants from representation domains and boundary crossings.
method_guards.emp04: Keep partition, state and label as orthogonal layers.
method_guards.emp06: Contradiction triggers diagnosis and bounded revision rather than claim inflation.
